bib.title: Toward Optimal Search and Retrieval for RAG

question: How do retriever properties (number of documents, gold document recall, ANN search accuracy, noise documents) affect downstream RAG performance on QA and attributed QA?
hypothesis: The ideal number of documents in a RAG prompt is directly related to the number of gold documents retrieved within that k.
contributions: Show how QA and citation metrics vary with number of retrieved documents.
Describe how RAG performance changes when fewer gold documents are in context.
Show that decreasing ANN search accuracy has only a minor effect on task performance.
Show that injecting noise degrades performance; no setting beats the gold ceiling, contrary to a prior report.

method.summary: Frozen retrievers (BGE-base with Intel SVS graph ANN; ColBERTv2) feed frozen Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 or Llama-2-7b-chat, with few-shot ALCE-style prompts. Authors vary k, force gold document recall to 0.5/0.7/0.9, tune ANN search recall to 0.7/0.9/0.95, and inject noise documents by similarity percentile.

datasets.name: ASQA
datasets.source: 12/20/2018 Wikipedia dump, 21M passages; 5 gold docs from ALCE (Gao et al.)

datasets.name: QAMPARI
datasets.source: 2018 Wikipedia dump; 5 gold docs from ALCE

datasets.name: Natural Questions (KILT)
datasets.preprocessing: adapted to attributed QA by prompting to cite documents

other.note: shorter context window than Mistral, per paper

inference.samples: inferred: one generation per query; bootstrap CIs over queries (1000 resamples)
inference.prompting: Order: system instruction, retrieved documents, query. 2-shot for Mistral, 1-shot for LLaMA for attributed QA; 0-shot for plain QA.
inference.retrieval: BGE-base via Intel SVS graph ANN (search_window_size sets recall); ColBERTv2; k in {1,2,3,4,5,10,20,100}; main analyses use 5-10 docs; ANN search recall targets 0.95/0.9/0.7 vs exact 1.0

parameters.gold_doc_recall_targets: 0.9, 0.7, 0.5 (non-gold nearest neighbours fill the rest of 10 docs)
parameters.noise: 5 random docs from each of ten similarity-decile bins, or from 5th-10th / 95th-100th neighbours; appended after gold or retrieved docs

other.hardware_retrieval: 2-socket Intel Xeon 8280L 2.70GHz, 28 cores, 384GB DDR4 per socket, Ubuntu 22.04
other.hardware_llm: NVIDIA Titan Xp / X Pascal / A40
other.runtime: ASQA/QAMPARI ~30 min Mistral, ~20 min LLaMA; NQ ~1.5 h Mistral, ~1 h LLaMA

metrics.name: recall@k (gold document recall)
metrics.definition: percentage of gold passages retrieved in k documents

metrics.name: search recall@k
metrics.definition: percentage of k exact nearest neighbours found among k approximate neighbours

metrics.name: EM recall
metrics.definition: percentage of dataset short answers appearing as exact substrings of output (NQ: top five gold answers)

metrics.name: citation recall
metrics.definition: whether each generated statement has citations that entail it (ALCE)

metrics.name: citation precision
metrics.definition: whether each citation is necessary to support a statement (ALCE)

eval.protocol: Per-query metrics averaged; 95% bootstrap CIs over queries (1000 iterations, 2.5/97.5 percentiles); non-overlap used for significance.

limits: Only one dense retriever (BGE-base) used for the ANN experiments; multi-vector ANN untested (authors).
Retriever and reader trained separately; end-to-end systems such as FiD may rely less on gold docs (authors).
Single run per condition; no seeds reported, temperature 1.
Noise effect on citation metrics inconsistent; authors say it needs further study.
No ANN latency or memory measurements reported; speed/memory benefit is asserted, not measured.
Prompt texts only in Figure 1 image, not in extracted text.
